target.$description: Invisible crop handle target, inside the padded editing stage.

mark.$description: Visible corner and edge handle size, independent of the target.

inset.$description: Space around the source for crop handles and their focus rings.

line.$description: Crop boundary and handle ink over the source pixels.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus on the active crop handle.

stroke.$description: Reserved crop boundary and handle stroke width.

shade.$description: Pixels outside the crop remain visible but dimmed.

shadeReach.$description: Clipped overlay extends beyond any source edge.

maxHeight.$description: Editing stage fits the window without hiding the actions.

viewportHeight.$description: Portrait image stage shrinks to the available review viewport.
